newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian farmers cautious on drought trends.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian farmers cautious on drought trends.

text.p: Drought improvement in the Australian state of New South Wales (NSW) appeared to have ended and livestock producers hoped for unseasonal summer rain, NSW Farmers' Association president Ian Donges said on Monday.
The latest report by NSW government showed that the reductions in drought affected areas during the past two years had stalled at 17 percent, he said in a statement.
This was a great improvement on last June when 58 percent of the state was drought declared, he said.
But while most grain growing areas had good crops, cattle and sheep producers had had a mixed season, he said.
Drought affected areas in the western division of the state were historically important wool growing areas, he said.
